title: Digital Days: a measurement-burst data pipeline for EMA, passive sensing, wearables and data donation
description: Executable protocol for a four-burst study of young adults (18-25): EMA item bank and AWARE-Light configuration, Google Health API (Fitbit) client, data-donation parsers and a client-side donation portal, alignment of all streams on one study-day timeline, QC, Mplus DSEM export, and an end-to-end simulation that recovers a planted within-person effect. Contains no participant data.
notes: Designed, written and tested by the author. Claude Code (Anthropic) was used by the author as a coding assistant.
